name: PDS P-006: the drill driver runbook states the stop-and-audit rule after two different-cause failures and names the [attempt-audit] marker, and drivers followed it in real drill loops (live, 2026-09-30)
summary: The runbook at apps/operator-docs/src/content/docs/agent-insights/hive-git-physical-drill-driver-runbook.mdx (committed blob 6639385df296, sha256 f0ebe3962a6a...) line 31 reads 'After two drill failures with different causes, stop re-running the drill. Before the next run, audit the harness for each failure's defect class ...' and names the marker [attempt-audit], the same literal the loop gate uses (packages/operator-core/lib/verification-attempts/loop-gate.ts ATTEMPT_AUDIT_MARKER = '[attempt-audit]'). In this plan's real same-box drill loop the driver posted two audit notes on WI-10003976 before re-running: thread-post 1151047 (08:03Z, before run 9) and 1151086 (08:43Z, before run 10), each beginning with [attempt-audit] and naming every distinct failure fingerprint in the attempt window.

assertions.criteria: The runbook states that after two drill failures with different causes the driver stops re-running and audits the harness first.
assertions.observed: Line 31 of the committed runbook states the rule verbatim ('After two drill failures with different causes, stop re-running the drill. Before the next run, audit the harness ...'). The page title is 'Driving the hive-git physical drill - reading a failure, re-running one phase, and when to stop re-running'.

assertions.criteria: The runbook names the attempt-audit marker.
assertions.observed: Line 31 contains the literal '[attempt-audit]', equal to ATTEMPT_AUDIT_MARKER exported by the loop gate. The doc-claims guard drill-driver-audit-rule.test.ts pins both (4/4 at test run 20227300) and fails on a runbook without the rule paragraph (copy-out mutation probe recorded on WI-10003977).

assertions.criteria: A real driver following the runbook audits before re-running after different-cause failures.
assertions.observed: coord_thread_posts 1151047 (2026-09-30T08:03:04Z) '[attempt-audit] 08:05Z su-d18cd980, before run 9. The attempt window, read from the task_ledger verificationAttempt rows: ...' and 1151086 (2026-09-30T08:43:08Z) '[attempt-audit] ... Audit of every distinct failure fingerprint since the last pass (06:11Z), before PDS run 10.' Run 10 (task 0munuyzonr9vulx1viy) was launched only after the second audit and got past the phase-A VM git-sync call that failed run 9, the defect class that audit named.

falsifier: The runbook does not state the rule, or the doc-claims test passes on a runbook without it.
command: SELECT id, created_at, left(body,260) FROM harness_shared.coord_thread_posts WHERE id IN (1151047,1151086)
note: The live plane for a runbook clause is the runbook as committed plus drivers acting on it in real drill loops; both are recorded here.
